project.title: Project
project.description: User custom website builder projects tracked by userId with specific component layouts and blocks

name.description: The name of the website project

trendlineNote.title: TrendlineNote
trendlineNote.description: Permanent text annotations and color tags pinned to specific trendline data points and dates

id.description: Unique identifier, usually formatted with userId and dateStr

dateStr.description: The unique date representation of the trendline point (e.g. Thu, Jul 16, 2026)

pointKey.description: Optional composite key identifying SKU or specific series data point

text.description: The content of the annotation note

tag.description: Optional category tag (e.g. Approved Promo, Legal Review, Surge Warning)

violationsCount.description: Number of detected violations associated with this date point

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the annotator

/projects/{projectId}.description: Website project definitions created by authenticated users

/trendlineNotes/{noteId}.description: Trendline data point annotations saved per user and synchronized across sessions
